text: Handing an AI agent the keys to a content API raises a plain worry: what keeps it from putting text nobody signed off into your website? In TextOS's API, the answer is a human gate that no machine account is allowed to turn into automatic execution. The rest of this note explains what the agent may do alone, what needs a person's sign-off, and how that sign-off is spent.
